contextReview.basis: Direct review: clear, sunny daytime East Asian urban streets with tiled apartment blocks, shop fronts, fruit stands, awnings, potted plants and parked scooters; hard direct sun with sharp shadows and a deep blue sky. No rain is depicted, and reflective paving is not read as rain. Humid is the producer's hot-humid styling setting, not a measurement. Mixed adult model casting is independent of the location.

casting.castingPolicy: mixed adult model appearance independent of the East Asian urban location (user 2026-11-03)

approval.evidence: The handoff and READY.json record that the five male editorials were explicitly approved (userApprovedEditorials true), with publication under the user's standing workflow authorization (2026-11-03, "앞으로도 승인 없이 진행"). Product images passed producer technical QA and producer visual QA on four backgrounds only.

reconstructionNotice: The pale fabric curtain at the shop door is part of the setting, not a product. The raised hand covers part of the cap, so the cap's far side is inferred. The camp shirt is the only top; the tote strap and raised arm hide parts of it, so its back and hidden side are conservatively reconstructed. The tote hangs against the hip, so its full shape is inferred. The trouser waist is partly hidden by the shirt. The watch is seen at an angle. Both sneakers are visible and listed as one pair. Brand, fibre composition, metal, performance and retail identity are unknown.

findings: Producer reviewed the editorials and all thirty products. Humid is a styling setting. Hidden fronts reconstructed conservatively. Exclude scene props; apply the female bag correction in the same publication. No brand, price or verified fiber claims.
